securityTopics.description: The commit message 'fix(Imports): corrige des erreurs de formats des cellules d'Excel et autorise les majuscule dans le nom de colonnes' suggests potential input validation issues when processing Excel files.  Improper handling of cell formats or column names could lead to SQL injection if the data is used in database queries without proper sanitization.

securityTopics.description: Several commits mention updating dependencies (e.g., 'fix(app): upgrade React / Next (CVE-2025-66478)', 'chore(staging): release 2025.45.1').  While updating dependencies is good practice, it's crucial to ensure the updates don't introduce new vulnerabilities. The CVE reference specifically indicates a security fix.

securityTopics.title: Broken Authentication/Session Management
securityTopics.description: The commit 'fix(Utilisateurs): Brevo: ne pas tenter de synchroniser le champ email vu qu'il est déjà connu par Brevo' indicates a potential issue with user authentication or session management.  Attempting to re-synchronize email addresses could lead to account takeover or other authentication-related vulnerabilities.
